title: Low-Speed Orbiting Aircraft Watch
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090 / readsb / tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=adsb:aircraft
| stats avg(speed_kt) as avg_speed, count as samples, max(altitude_ft) as altitude_ft by callsign
| where samples>30 AND avg_speed<200 AND altitude_ft>3000
| sort avg_speed
description: Finds aircraft that spent a long time overhead at relatively low speed, a simple approximation for holds, survey flights, or other interesting loiter patterns.
value: Your receiver sees a lot of straight-line transit traffic; this query teases out the flights that behaved unusually enough to merit a second look.
implementation: Forward ADS-B snapshots with speed and altitude; review long-duration, low-speed tracks to identify holds or specialty traffic.
visualization: Table of flights by average speed, altitude, and sample count.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which aircraft spent a long time circling or lingering overhead instead of just passing through.
